classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents a customer within the OpenCart system, managing customer data, login/logout processes, and session state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Customer object with dependencies from the registry, and loads customer data if a session customer_id exists.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a customer using email and password, updating session data upon success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears customer session data and resets customer properties.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns true if a customer is currently logged in (customer_id is set).

methods.name: getNewsletter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is subscribed to the newsletter.

methods.name: isSafe
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is marked as safe.

methods.name: isCommenter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is marked as a commenter.

methods.name: getAddressId
methods.description: Retrieves the default address ID for the customer.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the customer's current balance based on transactions.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Retrieves total reward points earned by the customer.
